name: Alberta

flag.description: A royal blue field with the provincial shield in the centre: a red St George's cross on white above snow-capped mountains, green hills, prairie and a golden wheat field.
flag.symbolism: The shield shows the province's landscape from west to east, from the Rocky Mountains through the foothills to the wheat-growing prairie, beneath the cross of St George.

hook: Alberta is a royal blue flag carrying a whole landscape on its shield: a red cross above the Rockies, green hills and golden wheat.
trivia: The shield on the flag was granted by royal warrant in 1907, two years after Alberta became a province.
Alberta is named after Princess Louise Caroline Alberta, a daughter of Queen Victoria.
